content:
// "Underground plumber"
// @license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
// @by Felix Roos
// @details inspired by Friendship - Let's not talk about it (1979) :)
// Remix @by Joe Goldbeck
// Borrowed from http://bit.ly/livecode-art-haus, originally available on https://strudel.cc/?e5Jtsh2cnzR5
setcps(1)

samples({ bd: 'bd/BT0A0D0.wav', sn: 'sn/ST0T0S3.wav', hh: 'hh/000_hh3closedhh.wav', cp: 'cp/HANDCLP0.wav',
}, 'https://loophole-letters.vercel.app/samples/tidal/')

const h = x=>x.transpose("<0@2 5 0 7 5 0 -5>/2")

stack(
  s("<<bd*2 bd> sn> [<hh [hh ~ hh hh]>]").fast(2).gain(.7),
  "[c2 a1 bb1 ~] ~"
  .echo(2, 1/16, 1)
  .slow(2)
  .layer(h)
  .note().s('sawtooth').gain(2)
  .clip(.4)
  .cutoff(500).decay(.12).sustain(0)
  ,
  "[g2,[c3 eb3]]".iter(4)
  .echoWith(4, 1/8, (x,n)=>x.transpose(n*12).velocity(Math.pow(.4,n)))
  .layer(h)
  .note().lpf(1200)
  .clip(.4)
  ,
  "[g3,[c4 eb4]]".iter(4)
  .echoWith(4, 1/8, (x,n)=>x.transpose(n*12).velocity(Math.pow(.2,n)))
  .layer(h).note()
  .clip(.4)
)
  .fast(2/3).room(0.8).size(4).phaser("<2 4 8 16 32>")
  ._pianoroll()

content:
// Borrowed from http://bit.ly/livecode-art-haus , originally available on https://strudel.tidalcycles.org/?oxcZRRihYt6D
setcps(1)

samples({
o0: 'samples/ocean/ocean_00.wav',
o1: 'samples/ocean/ocean_01.wav',
o2: 'samples/ocean/ocean_02.wav',
o3: 'samples/ocean/ocean_03.wav',
o4: 'samples/ocean/ocean_04.wav',
}, 'github:dqgorelick/tidal/main/');

stack(
"0".add("<0 2 4 3>/2")
.scale('a1 minor')
.struct("1(<3!3 5>, 8)")
.note()
.cutoff(sine.range(400, 3000).slow(8))
.room(0.6)
.sound("square"),

"{0 <1 2> 3 4 5 <6 7>}%8"
.struct("1(<3!3 5!2>,8)")
.off(1/2, n=>n.add("<5 8 10>"))
.scale('c4 major')
.note().sound("sine").hpf(400).legato(0.5).room(0.8).gain(0.5)
.mask("<0 1>/8"),

s("~ cp").slow("2")
.mask("<1 0>/8"),

s("~ ~ ~ bd(<2 4!2>, 8)").slow("2").lpf(1000)
.mask("<0 1 1 0>/8"),

s("bd(<2 3>,8)").lpf(1200)
.mask("<0 1@3>/8"),

s("~ sd")
.mask("<0 1@3>/8"),

s("hh*4(5,8,2)").lpf(1200)
.mask("<0 1>/16"),

s("<o3 o4!8>").striate(32).end(0.5).legato(0.5).clip(1).room(0.8)
.slow(4)
.mask("<0 1>/8"),

s("o1")
.slow(8).legato("<1 0.62>/8").clip(1)
.mask("<1 0@3>/16"),

s("<o1>")
)

content:
// Some techno - from https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5OYiOGxHxTQ
// Originally from DJ_Dave, see https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5OYiOGxHxTQ
// Small tweaks by AlienMind

samples('github:algorave-dave/samples')
samples('github:tidalcycles/dirt-samples')


const KICK_GAIN=slider(1,0,1)
const SD_GAIN=slider(0.965,0,1)
const HH_GAIN=slider(0.799,0,1)
const RIM_GAIN=slider(0.78,0,1)
const SH_GAIN=slider(0.549,0,1)
const ARP_GAIN=slider(0.863,0,1)
const BASS_GAIN=slider(0.782,0,1)



const gain = [
  "2",
  "{0.75 2.5}*4",
  "{0.75 2.5!9 0.75 2.5!5 0.75 2.5 0.75 2.5!7 0.75 2.5!3 <2.5 0.75> 2.5}%16",
]

const Structures = [
  "~",
  "x*4",
  "{x ~!9 x ~!5 x ~x ~!8 x ~!3 < ~ x > ~}%16"
]


drums: stack(
  s("bd!4").bank("rolandtr909").gain(KICK_GAIN).duck("2:3:4").duckattack(.2).duckdepth(.8),
  s("hh!16").bank("rolandtr909").gain(HH_GAIN),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("rolandtr909").gain(SD_GAIN),  
  s("{ ~ ~ rim ~ cp ~ rim cp ~!2 rim ~ cp ~ < rim ~ >!2}%8").bank("[KorgDDM110, dmx]").speed(1.2).fast(2).postgain(RIM_GAIN),
  s("sh").struct("[x!3 ~!2 x!10 ~]").postgain(0.5).lpf(7000).bank("RolandTR808").speed(0.8).jux(rev).room(sine).postgain(SH_GAIN)
)


$bassline: note("[eb1, eb2]!16 [f2, f1]!16 [g2, g1]!16 [f2, f1]!8 [bb2, bb1]!8")
  .sound("supersaw")
  .orbit(2)
  .slow(8)
  .postgain(BASS_GAIN)
  .room(0.6)
  .lpf(slider(1241.8,300,2000))
  .room(0.4)
  ._punchcard({height:200, width:1670})


const arpeggiator = [
  "{d4 bb3 eb3 d3 bb2 eb2}%16",
  "{c4 bb3 f3 c4 bb2 f2}%16",
  "{d4 bb3 g3 d3 bb2 g2}%16",
  "{c4 bb3 f3 c3 bb2 f2}%16"
]

$arp: note(pick(arpeggiator, "<0 1 2 3>".slow(2)))//.rev()
  .sound("supersaw")
  .lpf(300)
  .sustain(0.5).release(0.01).attack(0)
  .room(0.6)
  .lpenv(slider(6,1.25,6))
  .gain(ARP_GAIN)
  .orbit(3)
  ._punchcard({height:200, width:1670})
